digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 38
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Thistledown deprecates its v1 completion route
items.summary: Thistledown Gateway has removed the v1 completion route in favour of v2, and requests to it now fail.
items.whyItMatters: Teams calling v1 need to move to v2.

items.title: driftmark v2.1.0 adds run comparison
items.summary: driftmark v2.1.0 adds a compare command that lines up two runs and lists the cases whose scores changed. Output can be written as Markdown or JSON.
items.whyItMatters: The command exits non-zero when a score drops below a set threshold.

items.title: Mistvale queue adds tiered storage
items.summary: Mistvale Queue can move old segments to object storage and read them back on demand, so local disk keeps only the most recent segments.
items.whyItMatters: Tiered storage is configured per topic.

sources.title: Thistledown deprecates its v1 completion route
sources.summary: Thistledown Gateway deprecates the v1 completion route in favour of v2. The v1 route keeps working and will be removed in the next major release. Requests to v1 now return a deprecation header.

sources.title: driftmark v2.1.0 adds run comparison
sources.summary: driftmark v2.1.0 adds a compare command that lines up two runs and lists the cases whose scores changed. Output can be written as Markdown or JSON. The command exits non-zero when a score drops below a set threshold.

sources.title: Mistvale queue adds tiered storage
sources.summary: Mistvale Queue can move old segments to object storage and read them back on demand. Local disk keeps only the most recent segments. Tiered storage is configured per topic.
